page: Amazon Web Services r8gd.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 96 dedicated physical cores built on the ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture, running at 2.8 GHz with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage consists of 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier status for both cached small-block reads at 11076.56 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 481.08 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average category.

The instance exhibits strong database capabilities, achieving top-tier results in Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations, which handle 197.57 million operations per second. In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the integration of 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage directly into the instance profile reduces the need for external block storage attachments, optimizing the resource-to-cost ratio for data-heavy applications. For large language model inference, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds for medium and large models, though text generation for small models is relatively weak. This instance is suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale multi-threaded data processing, and software compilation workloads.
